reason: A desktop companion plugin focused on animated Nailong and other customizable pets, with Harness task-state display, settings controls, local image-based customization, and optional image-generation integration; public release still requires artwork-rights and native-installation documentation follow-up.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可定制的奶龙桌面宠物，支持透明悬浮显示、动画状态、设置管理以及基于图片创建自定义宠物。
summaries.en: A customizable Nailong desktop-pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness with transparent animated display, task-state cues, settings controls, and image-based custom pets.

capabilities: Displays an animated transparent desktop companion on macOS or inside the Harness window
Adds a Desktop Pet settings page with character, size, motion, preview, and position controls
Reads user-selected image files to create custom animated pets
Stores custom pet data and preferences locally in the current Harness browser profile
Can summarize Harness task states and activate Harness when the native pet is clicked
May use a separately configured image-generation credential for optional custom-pet rendering
